name: hud_ui_mgr_trigger_current_layout_on_activated
description: HudUiMgr::TriggerCurrentLayoutOnActivated dispatches the active layout OnActivated hook when a current layout exists and does nothing when no layout is active.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x413630 validates loading g_HudUiMgrCurrentLayout, returning when it is null, and tail-dispatching the HudLayoutBase OnActivated slot when non-null.
The native smoke verifies both the null current-layout path and the active current-layout OnActivated dispatch path.
